memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Preferences that help the agent work the way you do.

learning.label: Learn automatically
learning.description: Save stable preferences and clear corrections as you work. When off, nothing new is saved, and the agent can still use saved memories.

askFirst.label: Ask before saving
askFirst.description: Learned memories wait in Suggestions until you accept them, instead of being saved right away.
askFirst.pausedHint: Turn on automatic learning to change this.

create.label: Create memory
create.opened: Opened a new AI session in the task panel to save a memory.
create.pausedHint: Resume automatic learning to let the agent save memories.
create.enableSkill: Enable {{name}} in Extensions → Skills before creating with AI.

list.empty: No saved memories yet. Share a lasting preference as you work.

core.label: Always
core.hint: Every run includes its text, or only its description when the text is over 600 characters. Always-on memories share 3,000 characters; any that don't fit are listed in the memory index instead.

index.label: In the memory index
index.hint: Every run lists its name and description, and the agent reads it when it applies.

search.label: Search only
search.hint: The agent finds it only when it searches memory.

page.name: Name
page.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. The agent reads the memory by this name.
page.descriptionPlaceholder: What it is and when it applies
page.bodyNote: Changes apply to future memory reads.
page.changed: This memory changed after you opened it.
page.deleted: This memory was deleted elsewhere. Save keeps your edits as a new memory.

errors.nameFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, such as prefer-pnpm.
errors.nameTaken: Another memory already uses this name.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.outdated: Outdated: the memory changed after this suggestion.

problems.title: Some memories could not be read
problems.description: They stay out of runs until the files are fixed or removed.

feedback.storageNote: Stored on this device. Learning uses your configured model and may make additional model calls.

confirm.deleteDescription: This memory will be deleted. Existing conversation text will remain.
